title: Calendar date or dated reporting period
reason:
Provisional source-informed meaning. No canonical MeaningGraph entry or accepted equivalence; fresh Phase2 reconciliation required.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Separate calendar date, local wall time, UTC instant, duration, observation period and validity bounds. Timezone, calendar and source event role are prerequisites for conversion. Employees 9999-01-01 is an open-ended validity sentinel; shift time lacks a date. A midnight string alone does not establish a UTC instant. Date-only native/source semantics can reuse core date; timestamp truncation needs an explicit query transformation. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results.
